I am a woman of 48 years here in the South South. This small plot of 0.20 hectares I am renting, and I plant my cassava and cocoyam like I always do. I cannot waste money on chemical fertilizer for rented land — the landlord may not give me the plot next year, so I just put the small goat manure and household waste I gather. I use the cassava cuttings from my last harvest and from my neighbor, and my children help me with the weeding so I don't need to hire too many people.
